get.summary: One page of the books the caller may see, in one library or all

parameters.name: library
parameters.description: A library's ID; left out, every library the caller may see.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A rule tree as JSON that the books must match. A rule has a field, an op and values: author, series and tag take op in with names; language takes in with codes such as en; format takes in with formats such as epub; published takes between with a first and a last year, either empty for no limit. Every field but format also takes op empty without values. Rules combine under all, any and not.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: What the books are ordered by; title when left out.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The direction; asc when left out.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the page before.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many books a page holds, at most 200; 50 when left out.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What to look for in titles, authors and series; it may be misspelt or only begun. Fewer than three letters find nothing.
